title: Quality Governance & Communication Systems
summary: Built structured customer complaint RCA resolution tracking, meeting decision-tracking, and automated PDF exports to ensure closed-loop accountability.

projectItems.title: Customer Complaint & Root Cause Analysis (RCA) Engine
projectItems.summary: Designed a project quality workflow covering complaint logging, team assignment, 5-Why RCA investigation, corrective action tracking, manager approval, and automated PDF report export.
projectItems.problemStatement: Client complaints were handled informally via emails and calls without central tracking. Root cause analysis was rarely documented, and corrective actions lacked follow-up verification to ensure issue resolution.
projectItems.solution: Built a Zoho Projects/Creator quality module featuring structured complaint intake, RCA investigation templates (5-Why methodology), corrective action assignment with target dates, approval sign-offs, and automated PDF export.
projectItems.impact: Saved ~7 hours per month across users by streamlining complaint documentation, ensuring 100% of reported issues have verified corrective action plans.
projectItems.keyTakeaway: Replaces informal email troubleshooting with a structured, auditable quality system that ensures recurring problems are solved at the root cause.

projectItems.title: Meeting Minutes & Action Item Governance System
projectItems.summary: Implemented a structured meeting management tool capturing Minutes of Meeting (MoM), decisions made, linked project deliverables, assigned action items with deadlines, and searchable decision history.
projectItems.problemStatement: Action items discussed in project meetings were scattered in email threads or personal notes, resulting in forgotten commitments and loss of institutional memory during team transitions.
projectItems.solution: Developed an action tracking application in Zoho Projects/Creator to record meeting agendas, decisions, and action items with assigned owners and deadlines. Features automated notification alerts, dashboard follow-up views, and formatted PDF export.
projectItems.impact: Eliminated lost action items after project meetings and created a searchable repository of past project decisions for seamless team handovers.
projectItems.keyTakeaway: Turns verbal meeting commitments into trackable system actions linked directly to project deliverables.
